# Suku

> Suku is a personal life OS: tasks, projects, calendar (Google Calendar sync), habits, gym tracking, whiteboards and Suku AI (Ask Suku, Daily Briefing) in one calm dashboard. Installable web app, English and German.

- [App](https://suku.ink): sign in or try the demo
- [Impressum](https://www.suku.live/impressum)
- [Datenschutz](https://www.suku.live/datenschutz)
